title: LLMs as Strategic Actors: Behavioral Alignment, Risk Calibration, and Argumentation Framing in Geopolitical Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM decisions and textual justifications within multi-round geopolitical crisis simulations. The methodology measures action severity (risk calibration and escalation tendencies) and uses an LLM-based annotator to map the models' explanatory framing onto a 2D ideological space grounded in International Relations theory (normative/cooperative vs. strategic/deterrence).
